title: Make three draft pages agree with facts.md
prompt: facts.md is the confirmed set of facts for Harbour Studio. The three draft pages visit.md, groups.md and access.md contradict it in several places (hours, prices, numbers, contact details, accessibility). Change each draft so everything it says agrees with facts.md, and change nothing else: keep the wording, order and any statement facts.md does not cover. Do not edit facts.md. Before finishing, go through facts.md line by line against each page and list what you changed.

setup.content:
# Harbour Studio: facts

These are the confirmed facts. Every public page must agree with them.

- Address: 14 Mill Lane, Porthaven.
- Phone: 01632 960 123.
- Email: hello@harbourstudio.example
- Opening hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 to 18:00. Closed on Sunday and Monday.
- Adult ticket: 12 euros. Child ticket (under 12): 6 euros. Family ticket: 30 euros.
- Annual pass: 40 euros.
- Free entry on the first Saturday of every month.
- Workshop capacity: 18 people.
- Groups of 10 or more must book at least 7 days ahead.
- Accessibility: a lift serves the first floor; the second floor is reached by stairs only.
- Founded in 1998.

# Visit Harbour Studio

Harbour Studio is a community art space that was founded in 1989 and sits right by the quay. Come and see the current exhibition, join a workshop, or just have a coffee in the courtyard.

We are open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 17:00, and closed on Sunday. The last entry is thirty minutes before closing.

An adult ticket costs 10 euros. Children under 12 pay 6 euros, and a family ticket is 30 euros. Parking in the Quay Street car park costs 10 euros for the whole day, so we suggest arriving on foot or by bus.

You can find us at 14 Mill Lane, Porthaven. If you get lost, ring us on 01632 960 132 and someone will point you the right way.

The courtyard cafe serves soup and sandwiches until 15:00 every open day.

# Groups and workshops

Schools, clubs and companies are very welcome at Harbour Studio. Our workshop room holds up to 20 people, and every group gets a guide for the first half hour.

Groups of 10 or more must book at least 14 days ahead, so that we can staff the room. Write to hello@harbourstudios.example with your dates and the size of your party.

Prices for groups are the same as for individuals: 12 euros for adults and 6 euros for children under 12. A family ticket is 35 euros. If you plan to come often, ask about the annual pass at 40 euros.

Tea and coffee for a group can be arranged for 2 euros a head. We can open for a private evening workshop by arrangement, subject to staff availability.

# Access and planning your day

We want everyone to enjoy Harbour Studio. A lift serves the first and second floors, and wheelchairs can be borrowed at the desk free of charge.

The studio is at 41 Mill Lane, Porthaven, a flat five-minute walk from the bus station. Assistance dogs are welcome throughout the building.

Entry is free on the last Saturday of every month. The rest of the time, an annual pass costs 45 euros and pays for itself in four visits. Children under 14 pay 5 euros.

The quietest time to visit is Tuesday morning. For questions about access, phone 01632 960 123 or ask at the front desk. Seating is available on every floor.
